title: CardTopUpCompleted v1
description: The provider took the money of a top-up on its payment page (ADR 0009 p. 1, ADR 0010 p. 1); also a late or reconciled approval after the top-up failed or expired. Published by payments once per top-up; consumed by finance, which credits the rider's bonus account (CLIENT) or the driver's balance (DRIVER). A repayment of a rider's debt on an order carries obligation_order_id (REQ-PAY-18, issue #140): finance then pays the rider's RIDER_RECEIVABLE of that order instead of crediting the bonus account.

obligation_order_id.description: Only for a repayment: the order whose debt it pays.
